articles.summary: NEWS AND UPDATES Spreading Warmth to 200 Families in Caged Homes Regencell Foundation is honored to have partnered with the Society for Community Organization (SoCO) to extend practical aid, essential care packages, and warm smiles to 200 underserved families residing in caged homes and subdivided units across Hong Kong.
